why: How a server with these roles is named: <client>-<base>-<n>. Roles::serverBase (PHP) and EpClientForm.serverBase (the form's preview) must both give these.

cases.note: S3-Parser alone keeps its own first word: the family word is dropped only when the parts already hold it.
Role order, not the order the roles were ticked in.
Two families on one server, each short name one word, so nothing is dropped.
ES is written once. Without that the name would read ES-Data-ES-Master.
The ES family word survives when it is the first part: there is nothing before it to repeat.
Data repeats on purpose: only the FIRST word of a short name is dropped, and dropping more would make ES-Data and ES-Data-Warm the same name.

Every role that may share a server, on one server: the widest base the shipped roles can make, 83 characters. A host name is <client>-<base>-<n>, and Zabbix allows 128, so a client name of 41 characters or fewer always fits. test/e2e.test.php holds that bound.
